run_label_issues_main: run the label_issues script to auto-label a GitHub issue using the HuggingFace Inference API
run_get_existing_components: run get_existing_components to list all pipeline and model directory names in the diffusers source tree
review_SYSTEM_PROMPT: review the SYSTEM_PROMPT to understand the label categories and rules for the Diffusers issue labeler
review_VALID_LABELS: review the VALID_LABELS set to see all allowed label strings for Diffusers GitHub issues
refactor_main: refactor the main function to accept issue title and body as arguments instead of environment variables
